calendar_policy: Union of existing daily calendar and every source record date in 2022-2025. No other dates added.
zero_policy: No elderly report for a calendar date is counted as 0 reported cases; this does not prove no actual illness or complete reporting.
deduplication: None. Identical public fields may represent distinct patients because no patient ID is provided.

column_definitions.elderly_patients: 65세 이상 신고 기록 수(건); 고유 환자 식별 불가
column_definitions.all_age_reported_patients: 같은 날짜 전 연령 신고 기록 수
column_definitions.within_existing_calendar: 기존 전국 일일 데이터 날짜에 포함=1
